description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Set up a new event from the supplied event attributes. Returns the event API response. For a repeat of an existing event, use clone_event instead.

attributes.description: Event attributes (name, startDate, endDate, venue, currency, etc.). A physical venue is resolved through Google before saving. Supply venue.googlePlaceId or a venue name and address; ambiguous matches require a choice.

brandId.description: Brand ID. Defaults to active brand.

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to replay a recorded successful request; use a new key for a different change.

name: create_event
title: Create event
